title: Rust Engine
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A low-register 808-style subtractive bass with a roaring, broken character whose bit-crush slowly ramps from clean to shattered over the loop while a ladder filter sweeps and the pitch knock deepens. It corrodes from a tight punch into a fractured, degraded growl and resets.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 [f1 ab0] c1 f1 [eb1 f1] db1 c1>*2").s("sawtooth")
    .penv("<24 18 30 14>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay("<0.08 0.05 0.12>/4")
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(180, 1400)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(16).range(2, 6)).lpattack(0.004).lpdecay(0.16)
    .crush(saw.slow(16).range(16, 3))
    .coarse("<1 1 2 4>/8")
    .shape(sine.slow(32).range(0.2, 0.6))
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.22).sustain(0.45).release(0.05)
    .sometimesBy(0.12, x => x.speed(-1))
    .off(1/8, x => x.add(note(12)).crush(4).gain(0.22).pan(0.8))
    .room(0.18).gain(0.92)
)
